Subject: Reprioritizing LLM pilot — request to pause

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — I really appreciated the demo and the clear ROI examples. I wanted to flag that our leadership just pushed a Q2 roadmap reset: the CPO has pulled a number of initiatives (including the LLM pilot) into a later sprint and our headcount/budget is being redirected toward a cross-team analytics effort.

Two items from our side:
- We need to pause active pilots for at least the next quarter while we reallocate engineering resources.
- Our VP of Product (traveling this week) asked that we keep the evaluation on a short "paused" list and revisit in Q4 when hiring/budget settle.

Could you please:
1) Remove the demo from our shared calendar for now,
2) Share the SOC 2 one-pager and a brief mutual action plan so we can keep things on file, and
3) Confirm you'll set a reminder to check back in ~90 days?

Apologies for the churn — this is an internal reprioritization rather than feedback on Redwood. We still like what we saw and will reach back out when timing improves.

Best,
Amanda

Head of PM Ops | Elara Systems

Amanda — thanks for the heads up and totally understand.

I can do all three: I removed the demo from the shared calendar (confirmed), attaching a short mutual_action_plan.pdf and our SOC2 one-pager for your security/bench checks. I also set a placeholder 90-day check-in so we don't lose momentum (I'll mark it tentatively on my calendar and we can shift as needed).

When we're paused, we typically:
- Freeze the demo environment so there are no active runs (keeps costs down),
- Keep a slim set of artifacts (MA plan, SOC2, eval prompts) in the deal record so CS/SE can pick up quickly, and
- Schedule a soft touch in ~90 days unless you ask to push it further.

If it helps I can also create a short note in HubSpot with the rationale and expected revisit month (Q4) — Karthik, can you add the deal note and set the pipeline stage to "On Hold — Org Priority"?

Attach: mutual_action_plan.pdf (1 page), soc2-one-pager.pdf (1 page)

Would you like us to leave any lightweight pre-work available (sample prompts, eval set) or do you prefer we don't maintain any running artifacts while paused?

Thanks — I'll follow up after I log the pause in CRM.

Best,
